title: Insurance Claim Services Carrier Funding and Payment Routing Schedule
content:
Accounts receivable schedule for Insurance Claim Services files. It sets which carrier payment routes each arrangement accepts, how long an insured has to endorse a two-party check, and whether emergency advances and interim progress billings are open.

## Terms

- **Contractor-direct payments accepted** — whether carrier payments may be issued directly to the company, boolean.
- **Two-party checks accepted** — whether two-party checks naming the insured and the company are accepted for endorsement, boolean.
- **Endorsement days** — calendar days after the company notifies the insured of a two-party check by which the insured is asked to endorse it, count.
- **Mortgagee loss draft supported** — whether the company draws funds from a mortgagee loss-draft account through rebuild draw releases, boolean.
- **Advance request allowed** — whether the company may request an emergency mitigation advance from the carrier, boolean.
- **Emergency advance request limit** — largest emergency mitigation advance the company requests, USD.
- **Progress billing allowed** — whether interim progress billings are submitted to the carrier before job completion, boolean.
- **Progress billing minimum** — smallest interim progress billing submitted, USD.
- **Progress billing interval** — minimum calendar days between interim progress billings, count.
- **Payment allocation order** — order in which one dwelling-coverage carrier payment is applied across the jobs of a claim file.

## Payment routes

| Arrangement | Contractor-direct | Two-party checks | Endorsement days | Mortgagee loss draft | Allocation order |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Homeowner Direct Pay Claim Support | no | no | 10 | yes | mitigation then rebuild |
| Direction to Pay Claim Billing | yes | yes | 10 | yes | mitigation then rebuild |
| Assignment of Benefits Claim Billing | yes | yes | 10 | yes | mitigation then rebuild |
| Carrier Program Claim Billing | yes | no | 10 | yes | mitigation then rebuild |
| Public Adjuster Coordinated Claim Billing | no | yes | 10 | yes | mitigation then rebuild |
| Commercial Large Loss Claim Administration | yes | yes | 10 | yes | mitigation then rebuild |

## Advances and progress billing

| Arrangement | Advance allowed | Advance limit (USD) | Progress billing allowed | Progress minimum (USD) | Interval (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Homeowner Direct Pay Claim Support | no | 0.00 | no | 0.00 | 0 |
| Direction to Pay Claim Billing | yes | 5000.00 | no | 0.00 | 0 |
| Assignment of Benefits Claim Billing | yes | 7500.00 | no | 0.00 | 0 |
| Carrier Program Claim Billing | no | 0.00 | no | 0.00 | 0 |
| Public Adjuster Coordinated Claim Billing | yes | 5000.00 | no | 0.00 | 0 |
| Commercial Large Loss Claim Administration | yes | 50000.00 | yes | 25000.00 | 30 |

Progress billing is open only on Commercial Large Loss Claim Administration, at a minimum of 25000.00 USD and at least 30 calendar days apart. Every arrangement applies a dwelling-coverage payment in the mitigation-then-rebuild order.
